paragraphs: Chapter 897
Episode 225. Unwanted Reunion (2)
Before Luna could even respond, Mote swiftly carried Sirius into the white dimensional gate.
Jin exhaled a sigh of relief as he watched the dimensional gate close. He had a strong intuition that a brother from hell was about to be summoned from the suddenly amplified crack.
"Fortunately, our Ice Princess is more perceptive than I thought. If Sirius had persisted any longer, it would have been a headache. I'll have to praise him when we get back."
"You did well too. Has your head cleared a bit while recovering this time?"
For the demons of the Netherworld who were battling Luna and Sirius, this was a difficult situation to quickly understand.
They felt greatly displeased as the two treated them like air while they conspired.

However, they couldn't act rashly. Luna had been pushing them back with her monstrous strength, and suddenly, Jin, the head of the Barmel Union and the closest to being the greatest swordsman, appeared with his guardian dragon.
[And you guys are not so dull either, huh? If you had rushed in before Sirius left, you would have died horribly. But you did well by holding back. Hmm?]
Muraikan transformed into his true form and looked around at the demons. The three generals and their soldiers surrounded the two, visibly tense.
"I don't know what your little scheme is, but sending Sirius away was a mistake!"
As one of the generals shouted, Muraikan snorted.

[Huh, you even try to bluff in a cute way. Let me put you out of your misery all at once. If you want to hold onto any hope, pray that the superior coming out of that crack is Paerito or whatever his name is. I'm really curious about him.]

Muraikan released his aura as soon as he finished speaking, spreading out his Black Shackles. In an instant, a massive barrier of darkness covered the area, and a black chain descended from behind the general who had just shouted.
The general, already tired from facing Luna, could not avoid the Black Shackles. The shackles pierced through his back and spread like roots, annihilating the soldiers around him with their power.
It all happened in just about 3 seconds. The remaining generals gave a scattered command in horror, but already, dark chains were raining down over their heads.
The remaining two generals narrowly avoided the falling chains, but their subordinates did not. Their officers and soldiers were swallowed up into the darkness of the aura.
While Muraikan's merciless slaughter continued, the fact that Jin hadn't even drawn his sword sent chills down their spines.
Jin was still watching the amplifying crack.
'Are there two Demon Kings? One doesn't seem as exceptional compared to the other Demon Kings we've seen before. But the other one has quite a hefty aura.'

The amplified crack was opening. The surviving generals ran desperately towards the crack, but their forces were all but annihilated. Even before Jin and Muraikan arrived, they were on the verge of destruction.
The generals were pierced by the chains of darkness, barely reaching the rift in their battered state. The rift revealed new Demon Lords being summoned.
"Lord Druaga...!"
"Lord Seiker!"

Upon hearing the names the generals desperately cried out, Jin quickly identified who they were. Thanks to the information he received about the Demon Lords and main forces of the Demon World from Biseps.
'Druaga Killet, Seiker Highta. Then the heavy aura must belong to Druaga.'
Seiker Highta was a Demon Lord who attended the coronation party of Ragal Foon, and the Killet family was an old ally of the Foon family.
'So that Ragal bastard sent his own men to use the brothers in hell.'
Fssh-!

The first thing Druaga did upon escaping from the rift was piercing through the necks of the two generals who came to him with his fingernails. Murakan frowned at the sight, and Jin focused his gaze on the black coffin summoned between Druaga and Seiker.
His brother should have been in that coffin.
"Lucky that you two survived. I will make good use of your remaining power."
Saying so, Druaga used the bodies of the generals as a shield to block Murakan's chains of darkness.
[Don't you demons know the concept of camaraderie?]
The Demon Lords didn't answer, just stared at Jin and Murakan, as if asking why they, and not Baekgyeong, were there.
"...Seiker, I will return."
"Yeah, I understand... What? What did you say?"
Before Seiker could question further, Druaga used the bodies of the freshly killed generals as a sacrifice to open a dimensional portal. It was a portal leading to Grosh Castle.
"Hey, Druaga! You crazy, hey!"
"If you want to blame someone, blame the generals. If a couple more of them had survived, I could have opened a two-person portal..."
And so, Druaga abandoned the battlefield.
The only ones left in the magic-polluted Oken Desert were now Seiker, a few lower-ranked demons, and the black coffin Druaga left behind.
The reason Druaga left his position was simple.
The fact that Jin and Murakan are here instead of Luna means there is a 'spy of Biseps' in the Dokma Castle, just as Ragal said.
And it was also evidence that Biseps had joined hands with Runkandel.

Having confirmed this, there was no need for him to foolishly die here. Druaga, although one of the stronger Demon Lords, was well aware that he had no chance against Jin and Murakan. Especially without even a slice of Zito's flesh.
A moment of silence passed. Seiker clenched his teeth while looking at the dimension portal that closed in the blink of an eye.
"This trash...!"
[I asked if you had any comradeship, and you answered not with words but with actions. Wow, what are you guys? Huh? How can beings nearly immortal have such lack of dignity?]
As Jin began to stride forward, Siker hastily opened the coffin.
Since Druaga had fled alone, the only hope Siker could hold onto was a hostage situation.
"Don't come any closer! If you come any closer, I will annihilate this guy!"
Clink-!
The coffin opened. Seeing the person who came out of it, Jin had no choice but to widen his eyes in surprise.
'...Was it Anne?'
Anne Lun Kendall.
She was sobbing, caught in Siker's grip.
And among this generation of Lun Kendalls, there was no one who could imagine Anne Lun Kendall sobbing miserably, regardless of their relationship with her.

Even though she had never made a name for herself as a sword knight of Lun Kendall like the other higher-ranked individuals, and always faced discrimination from the predators of the family, eventually falling from grace and facing a futile end.

Anne was a Lun Kendall. She was a monster stained with hatred and madness, not the type to collapse from human sorrow. She was even more twisted than the Tona brothers, who were known as insane killers in Jin's previous life.
Seeing such an Anne looking miserable as if she was a sinner, even Jin felt strange.
And Jin was sure. If Luna had been here, seeing this would have caused her to feel intense guilt. Anne was not in a soul state, she looked just like she did when she was alive.
"Jin... I'm sorry. Even in death, I can't be of any help to the family."
Even more so, Anne was saying this with a cracked voice.
[Huh? What is this... Is that the real Anne? What on earth did she go through in hell?]
"I told you not to come... Yes. It has to be like this, seeing my kin suffer like this."
"Jin! Don't worry about me and just kill this guy!"
"Shut up!"

"I'm okay with being annihilated. No, I rather want to be annihilated. In hell, I was able to realize the mistakes I had made. I don't want to be tortured anymore. So, please... kill this guy and end me too...!"
Not only Jin and Murakan, but no one expected this attitude from Anne.

'I heard that the tuning was over, why is she like this? Druaga is like this too, and so is Ragal. What's going on? Is there something I don't know? Have I been used and discarded? Damn, it seems unlikely that I'll survive and return at this rate, unless Jin Lun Kendall has a special affection for this human...!'
Anne continued to scream in a desperate voice for him to annihilate her.
"Murakan, take care of him. I need to talk to Anne."
"Understood."
Creak! One of the black chains Murakan had hidden penetrated through the right arm of Siker, who was holding Anne.
"Ugh!"
"Are you insane? Do you think this kind of hostage drama will work with me and the kid? Do something sensible. I'm annoyed. You need to be hit by me."
Murakan quickly separated Anne from Siker. From the start, even if Jin had true affection for Anne, a hostage drama couldn't be established with just Siker's abilities.

Murakan began to press Siker, and Jin approached Anne. Even when Jin came in front of her, Anne was just weeping, gnawing at her own body on the ground. Crimson blood flowed from her body, scratched by her own nails.
Even for Jin, it was impossible not to feel a bit uncomfortable.

"…Anne. Honestly, even since we were alive, I had a feeling that your end wouldn't be great. However, you committed even more horrific acts than I thought, and now… you're experiencing the worst possible end for a human."
The uncomfortable feeling was a fact, but he didn't feel sympathy. If he had to choose, what Jin felt now was regret.
You're still a Runcandel, you're still my sibling with the same blood running through you, couldn't you have lived a better life?

If you're a villain, I wish you were a cool villain with your own pride and ambition, or like the Tona brothers, who repented before crossing the line and regretted their past sins and became a pillar of the family, or just faded away normally after causing a reasonable accident.
There wouldn't have been such a reunion not even worth of sympathy like now.
Jin looked down at Anne quietly.
"I can neither sympathize with nor pity you. You're worse than a karmic bond because you're my kin."
"I'm sorry, I have nothing to say."
"The other siblings will be used for the same purpose as you. To torment sister Luna. Where are they?"
"I don't know... I've never met them. We were all in different prisons. Just... finish me off. Erase this wretch named Anne Runcandel from this world..."
Jin slowly closed and opened his eyes.
It was time to do what he had to do as a member of the Runcandel family.
"There's a thing called the path of reincarnation. Since you won't be able to go there, I can't even wish for you to choose a better life in your next life. Farewell, Anne."
At the moment he was about to draw his sword,
Jin, suddenly sensing an unpleasant sensation, hurriedly withdrew. A sharp sword aura was bursting from the spot where Jin had been standing.
It was Anne's sword aura.
"Ah, as expected. The youngest one, this doesn't work on you at all. If it was the older sister, she would be unable to do anything with a troubled face by now."
